headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 4 studies yielded an effect size of 0.64 (95% CI: 0.4–1.04), indicating no statistically significant association between Vitamin E and aggressive prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 76.49%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
